questions.question: What is the difference between a patio and a patio cover?
questions.answer: A patio is the paved outdoor living area. A patio cover is a roofed structure over part of it that adds shade and shelter. We design both together with the rest of your backyard.

questions.question: Can a patio cover include a fireplace or outdoor kitchen?
questions.answer: Yes. A covered patio can include a fireplace or fire pit, seating, dining, and an outdoor kitchen, planned as one coordinated space.

questions.question: Can you design the patio together with a pool?
questions.answer: Yes. A patio cover is an important part of our pool builds, so we design the shade, the seating, and the view together with the pool and spa.

questions.question: Can you add a patio cover to my existing backyard?
questions.answer: Yes. Tell us about your yard during the free design consultation. We design the patio and cover to fit what you already have, and to work with a pool, kitchen, or fire feature if you add one later.

questions.question: Do I need a permit or HOA approval?
questions.answer: Requirements depend on your city or county and your homeowners association, so it is worth checking early. Tell us about your property during the free design consultation and we will talk through next steps.

questions.question: How much does a custom patio or patio cover cost?
questions.answer: The cost depends on the size, the structure and materials, and features such as a fireplace, lighting, or an outdoor kitchen. After your free design consultation we provide a quote for your project.

questions.question: Can I see the patio before it is built?
questions.answer: Yes. We create a 3D model of your outdoor space, so you can see the shade, the seating, and the fire features in place before construction begins.
